reason: An epigynous flower is one whose ovary is inferior, so the value belongs on the flower's plant ovary (PO_0009072). 'Tepals/disk epigynous' means inserted on top of the ovary and should go through pattern 09 (inserted into PATO_0000624, relative to the ovary). 'Gousses épigées' (epigeal) is a different word mixed in by mistake and should be dropped.

'Lower lip projected' and 'node slightly projected' mean standing out beyond the rest of the part, which is PATO protruding. 'With a projection' examples name a part, not a quality, and should not use this rule.
A scrambler is a plant that climbs by leaning on its support. This follows the previous review's rule mapping 'scrambling' to FLOPO climbing (C355), with the whole plant as bearer.
This is a measured length (PATO_0000122) of the plant cells (PO_0009002) of the leaf lamina. The bearer is the cell as part of the leaf, not the leaf itself, so no new term is needed.
A compound of cut/incised (PATO_0001978) and serrated (PATO_0001206), modified by 'irregularly'. Both parts already have terms.

This is thickness (PATO_0000915) of a wall, with 'thickened' meaning increased thickness (PATO_0000591). The bearer varies: a cell wall in the moss leaf cells, or the organ wall in fruit and cupule. The bearer has to be resolved for each record, not handled with a term.
Size (PATO_0000117) of plant cells (PO_0009002) that are part of the named organ. 'Cells small' is decreased size, said of the cells.
Width (PATO_0000921) measured on the plant organ base (FLOPO_0985024) of the named part. This is a bearer region plus a measure, not a new quality.
Width (PATO_0000921) of plant cells (PO_0009002) of the leaf lamina. 'L × W µm' should be split into length and width (pattern 11 if given as a ratio).
'Sinuate-margined' simply says the margin is sinuate, so it is the existing FLOPO sinuate value.
The examples are mixed: ovary and anther diameters were picked up by mistake, and Sphagnum hyaline-cell pores have no bearer class. 'Pore' was rejected as a generic part in the previous review.
Thecae or stigma tips that are not divergent do not spread apart. PATO 'divergent from' (PATO_0002424) is a relational attribute and cannot be negated as a value, so this negates spreading instead.
Length (PATO_0000122) of plant cells (PO_0009002) in the leaf apex (PO_0020137). This is a bearer of cell-in-region plus a measurement.
Size (PATO_0000117) of the plant cells (PO_0009002) of the leaf lamina (PO_0020039), with a measured value. This is the same case as 'cell size'.
A comparison of length with the flowers. 'Exceeding' is pattern 09 (increased length PATO_0000573) and 'equaling' is pattern 10; the 'or' joins them as alternatives (pattern 07).
There is no PO or FLOPO class for Sphagnum hyaline cells or their pores, and 'pore' alone was rejected as a generic part. A bearer class should be proposed as an anatomy candidate first.
Width (PATO_0000921, measured as in pattern 02) of plant cells (PO_0009002) in the distal position of the leaf. The position is pattern 18.
Erect-appressed leaves point upward and lie against the stem, and appressed already implies the erect direction. 'Laxly' is a degree modifier and is dropped.
Height (PATO_0000119) of the basal membrane of the peristome (PO_0030042). PO has no class for the basal membrane, so the bearer stays the peristome with the region in the context text.
Length (PATO_0000122, measured as in pattern 02) of plant cells (PO_0009002) in the distal position of the leaf.
An indefinite count ('many') of flowers, split through config/flora_counted_parts.tsv (flowered → flower), exactly as 'few-flowered' in pattern 13.
This is an attribute word, not a value. The values next to it already have their own rules or terms ('croissant avec le fruit' = accrescent FLOPO:0991082; sympodial, monopodial, cespitose).
'Inserted at the throat of the corolla' relates a part to another part: inserted into (PATO_0000624), with the region kept in comparison_text.
The word names a part. 'Without rhizomes' is the absence pattern 15, and 'rhizome inconspicuous' takes the rhizome as bearer.

A stem rooting at its nodes bears shoot-borne (adventitious) roots at the stem nodes (PO_0020141). 'Not rooting' is the absence. This is not the same as creeping (FLOPO:0991009), which also needs a prostrate habit.
The word names a part, and PO bark exists. 'Inner/outer bark' should be qualified by position.

target: new: merosity (count of members per whorl)
reason: '5-merous' gives the number of members in each whorl, with the whorl or flower as carrier. Pattern 03 says 'merous' names no single part and is not split, so it needs its own count pattern rather than a term.
Furfuraceous already has the exact synonym scurfy, and scurfy is a subclass of scaly (lepidote, PATO_0001804). The compound therefore says no more than scurfy.
The word names the stamen filament, a PO part. Its qualities (glabrous, connate, widened) go on it.
This is the attribute (spatial pattern PATO_0000060), not a value. The actual values in the examples already have terms: mottled PATO_0002274, banded PATO_0001946.
